name: B10-0197/2026 (The Left) – Supporting democratic resilience in Armenia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting democratic resilience in Armenia
part_text:
This is a resolution stating the European Parliament's position, not a law. It asks the EU to treat Armenia as a candidate country and give it the same technical and financial help as others, based on reforms. It calls for free and fair elections in June 2026, deeper work on rule of law, workers' rights and LGBTIQ+ rights, and progress on visa-free travel. It welcomes the Armenia-Azerbaijan peace deal and criticises Azerbaijan over displaced Armenians and destroyed heritage.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament asks the EU to back Armenia's reforms and visa talks.
- Armenia's government, courts, media and workers are affected; elections are due 7 June 2026.
- Next: EU-Armenia summit in Yerevan on 4-5 May 2026.
